title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs Administration Clause: Carry-Forward Share at the Close of a Manufacturer Copay Card Period
content:
**Clause 1.** When a benefit period of a Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs ends, a carry-forward is kept on the program and every other dollar left lapses in the closing entry; the closing entry books the dollars left less the carry-forward, rounded to the cent half up.

**Clause 2.** The carry-forward share follows the benefit entries standing on the program, counted as benefit entries less benefit reversals: **8 or more** keep **30 percent** of the dollars left, **5 to 7** keep **15 percent**, and fewer keep nothing. The carry-forward starts from the dollars left times that share, rounded to the cent half up.

| Standing benefit entries | Share of the dollars left kept |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | 30 percent |
| 5 to 7 | 15 percent |
| 4 or fewer | nothing |

**Hypothetical cards with $2450.00 left.**

- 9 benefit entries, 1 reversed: 8 standing, 30 percent, $735.00.
- 8 benefit entries, 1 reversed: 7 standing, 15 percent, $367.50.
- 5 benefit entries, 1 reversed: 4 standing, nothing kept; the closing entry books the whole $2450.00.
